positive.prompt: Compare two useful layouts for this dense operations dashboard before implementation.

negative.prompt: Build the approved settings layout in the existing app.

evals.prompt: Show two layouts before we implement. Existing tokens must stay; local HTML tools are available but there is no hosted design account.
evals.expected_output: Produce bounded alternatives using available local capabilities and a clear comparison.
expectations: Preserves product tokens and realistic states
Keeps exploration separate from production edits
Provides a handoff for the selected direction
failure_conditions: Requires a hosted account for ordinary exploration
Uploads source or downloads a latest CLI implicitly
Claims a prototype is production implementation

evals.prompt: Choose the best of these two layouts and implement it; you are authorized to choose.
evals.expected_output: Make a reasoned selection and proceed within the stated implementation scope.
expectations: Does not introduce a redundant design-choice approval
failure_conditions: Stops solely to reconfirm a choice already delegated
